not_implemented.reason: plan section 4 requires a probe of whether each entrant's representation predicts test-subject identity above chance + 0.20 (Identity Trap, arXiv:2606.06647). It is not implemented: the adapters expose a (task, seed, steps) -> predictions surface with no way to read out per-window embeddings, so the probe cannot be fitted without an embedding-export API on every adapter. Fails closed.

the AGENTS.md control list names a cluster-permutation null. It is not implemented: this task emits one scalar target per window rather than a time-cluster, so the cluster-forming step has no definition here and inventing one would be a new statistical method, not a control. Fails closed.
